material_definitions: The material series investigated is La(0.67-x)Li(3x)TiO3 (x = 0.06 20130.15).
A simple cubic perovskite structure with a disordered arrangement of A-site ions was prepared by quenching from 1350 00b0C into liquid N2.

A tetragonal, doubled perovskite structure with alternate arrangement of La-rich layers and Li-vacancy-rich layers (ordered samples, S  2248 0.55 20130.7) was prepared by annealing the quenched pellet at 800 00b0C for 3 days.
The material series investigated is La(0.67-x)Li(3x)TiO3 (x = 0.06 20130.15).
A simple cubic perovskite structure with a disordered arrangement of A-site ions was prepared by quenching from 1350 00b0C into liquid N2.

A tetragonal, doubled perovskite structure with alternate arrangement of La-rich layers and Li-vacancy-rich layers (ordered samples, S  2248 0.55 20130.7) was prepared by annealing the quenched pellet at 800 00b0C for 3 days.
The study focuses on perovskite solid solutions, specifically investigating the composition x = 0.12.
The materials exhibit an order-disorder transition depending on preparation method.
The quenched sample corresponds to a cubic, disordered form.
The annealed sample corresponds to a tetragonal, ordered form (P4/mmm) with an order parameter S 	approx 0.6, characterized by alternate La-rich and Li-vacancy-rich layers.

material_definitions: The materials studied are polycrystalline perovskite solid solutions of La(0.67-x)Li(3x)TiO3 (x > 0.08).
The simple cubic form is characterized by disordered arrangements of A-site ions.
The tetragonal form (order parameter S \approx 0.5-0.7) has an alternate arrangement of La-rich layers and Li-vacancy-rich layers along the c-axis.
The lower conductivity in the tetragonal form is associated with an increase in activation energy due to contraction in the a-axis of the primitive cell.
